company.shortDescription: Building AI that helps hospitals not only survive, but thrive.
company.description:
Hospitals are under more pressure than ever, yet every day they continue to provide extraordinary care to their communities. At SmarterDx, we're building frontier clinical AI that helps health systems capture the full complexity of patient cases.

This isn't AI for AI's sake. Every product we build helps hospitals recover earned revenue, improve quality, reduce denials, and operate more sustainably. Together, we've helped deliver more than $1 billion in value to health systems across the country.

If you want your work to have a measurable, meaningful impact on healthcare, consider growing your career with SmarterDx.
